intent: Read-only same-observation first-action comparison; associative diagnostic only
sources: 160 completed official PPO_real_rewards training trajectories, iterations 1-8, scenario seeds 930001-930016
selection: 62 equally spaced integer indices from first controlled origin through final origin with 48 actual future outcomes, per episode; no outcome-based sampling
anchor: persistent episode anchor reconstructed exactly with original NumPy2 training-runtime formula from first control history last delivered basal; never current-rate proxy
action: ppo_worker.physical merges hold classes via max logits, then argmax physical class; offsets 0,-0.25,+0.25 U/h, clamp0..20
limitations: Correlated training states and actual future outcomes from generating stochastic PPO policy; no counterfactual efficacy or held-out confirmation claim
